prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable full-bleed 16:9 landscape background plate for a gentle children's mathematical counting series, no UI and no characters.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND WORLD reference: the existing Num-Num Numbers bright garden. Create a NEW companion location at luminous early twilight rather than editing its foreground. Match the warm brown hand-drawn outlines, soft watercolor/gouache on subtle paper texture, rounded friendly foliage, cheerful simple shapes and crafted picture-book finish.
Scene: a peaceful lantern garden at blue-lilac dusk. Pale periwinkle-blue sky fading to warm peach near a low horizon, a softly curving grassy clearing, leafy trees framing only the far left and far right edges, low mint/teal bushes, a small still pond tucked into the far left background. Tiny white and butter-yellow flowers only near lower edges. The whole foreground remains bright enough for a pale-yellow bear to be readable. Friendly and calm, not dark or spooky.
Composition: wide straight-on fixed-camera establishing plate. Horizon approximately 58 percent down. Large uncluttered empty central/right area (x34% to96%, y15% to84%) and an empty grounded character area at left (x5% to30%, y20% to87%). Foreground grassy stage can be darker mint but must remain soft and airy. Trees stay at edges. Leave room for separately rendered bit-lantern teaching panels.
No bear, no animals, no people, no digits, no letters, no title, no boards, no lamps/lanterns in the middle, no floating mathematical symbols, no logos, no watermark, no dense field of glowing points. Avoid photorealism, neon, shiny 3D, hard gradients, horror-night lighting. Output one clean landscape 16:9 illustration.
purpose: Reusable independent background plate for binary-counting preproduction; approval for a final video is pending.
